description: VCP v3.2 context encoding and decoding vectors. Situational dimensions use pipe-separated symbol and value groups. Personal-state dimensions use canonical field names with value and intensity (1-5). U+2016 DOUBLE VERTICAL LINE separates the situational and personal bands.

vectors.description: Empty context: no dimensions set
Situational only: time dimension with sunrise emoji

expected.note: The personal-band separator U+2016 is absent when personal state is empty.

vectors.description: Personal only: cognitive dimension

expected.note: Personal-only wire starts with the U+2016 band separator.

vectors.description: Full roundtrip: situational time + space, personal cognitive + emotional
Parse empty wire string
Serde roundtrip: context survives JSON serialization and deserialization

expected.note: JSON roundtrip preserves the canonical perceived_urgency value and intensity.

vectors.description: Context with all nine core situational dimensions
Emergency context: contains emergency indicators

expected.note: The alarm emoji in OCCASION or CONSTRAINTS indicates an emergency context

vectors.description: Children present indicator

expected.note: Baby emoji in COMPANY dimension indicates children are present

vectors.description: Canonical CULTURE and SYSTEM_CONTEXT vocabularies (VCP/A 2.1)

expected.note: CULTURE carries communication styles (hierarchical, collectivist); SYSTEM_CONTEXT carries the computing environment (monitored_environment). The retired online/degraded/offline/sandboxed/testing and casual/mixed values are not canonical.

vectors.description: Unknown values and unknown dimension groups are tolerated and passed through (VCP/A 2.3)

expected.note: 😢 is not an OCCASION value in VCP/A 2.2 and is kept as written. 🦄 and 🪐 are not dimension symbols, so their groups are kept, ignored for adaptation, and re-encoded after the known dimensions. A strict validator reports all three.

vectors.description: A malformed context string is still rejected: empty group

expected.note: An empty group is a validation error, not an unknown value (VCP/A 2.3).

vectors.description: Personal-only context begins with the separator (VCP/A 2.3)

expected.note: A string with personal state only begins with U+2016 and has no situational band.

vectors.description: Intensity with a leading zero is malformed

expected.note: An intensity is exactly one digit from 1 to 5; 04, 0 and 6 are malformed (VCP/A 2.3), not unknown values.

vectors.description: A sub-signal never appears in a context string; every binding reads the Rust encoding

expected.note: The extended sub-signal travels only on the CSM-1 R-line or in a VCP-X-Personal signal object (VCP/A 2.3 Sub-signals). The runner feeds the Rust output to Python and WebMCP.

vectors.description: VCP/A 2.4 personal-only example with omitted intensities

expected.note: Exact string from VCP-Spec schemas/examples/vcp-adaptation-context.valid-personal-only.json. An omitted intensity stays omitted on re-encode.

vectors.description: A known emergency value keeps its meaning next to an unknown value

expected.note: 🦖 is not an OCCASION value; 🚨 still signals an emergency (VCP/A 2.3).

vectors.description: A repeated situational dimension is malformed

expected.note: Values for one dimension share a group (VCP/A 2.3).

vectors.description: A repeated personal-state dimension is malformed

expected.note: Values for one dimension share a group (VCP/A 2.3).

vectors.description: RELATIONSHIP with a tie strength only
RELATIONSHIP with a function only
A sub-signal suffix in a context string is malformed
A ZWJ sequence that starts with a known value is one unknown value

expected.note: 👁️‍🗨️ (eye in speech bubble) is not SYSTEM_CONTEXT 👁️ monitored_environment; decoders keep it whole as an unknown value (VCP/A 2.3).

vectors.description: A skin-tone modifier stays with its base emoji

expected.note: 👶🏽 is kept as one unknown COMPANY value, not 👶 children plus a stray modifier.

vectors.description: A VS16 tail on a value without one stays with it

expected.note: 🏠️ (with U+FE0F) is kept as one unknown SPACE value, not 🏠 shared_space plus a stray selector.
